name: tianshu-workbuddy-connect

tianshu.name: tianshu-workbuddy-connect
tianshu.description: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 内置的模型（DeepSeek / GLM / Kimi / MiniMax / Hy3）接入天枢，复用 App 登录态，零配置

tools.name: workbuddy_connect
tools.description: 接入 WorkBuddy 模型：读取桌面 App 登录态、拉起本地网关并写回天枢 provider 配置

tools.name: workbuddy_status
tools.description: 查看 WorkBuddy 接入状态：账号、令牌有效期、网关健康、模型数量

tools.name: workbuddy_models
tools.description: 列出当前账号可用的 WorkBuddy 模型及其上下文窗口与思考档位

tools.name: workbuddy_refresh
tools.description: 刷新 WorkBuddy 登录令牌并重新同步模型目录到天枢配置

tools.name: workbuddy_doctor
tools.description: 诊断 WorkBuddy 接入链路的每一环（凭据、解密、网关、配置漂移）

tools.name: workbuddy_logout
tools.description: 断开 WorkBuddy 接入：移除 provider 配置与插件自留凭据副本
